title: Deeplus Canonical HIR-H1 R11 construction-lifecycle successor
description: Machine-bound canonical HIR payload. Audit baseline, audit status, and product status are deliberately outside the instance semantic projection.

UnsignedMagnitude.description: Shortest lowercase hexadecimal unsigned big-endian byte magnitude; 00 is the sole zero.

PositiveMagnitude.description: Shortest lowercase hexadecimal strictly-positive unsigned big-endian byte magnitude.

x-deeplus-machine-contract.occurrence_profile_rule: The root source_profile is the sole occurrence profile. Nested profile overrides do not exist.
x-deeplus-machine-contract.preview_pattern_rule: A Preview pattern exists only in EXPLICIT_PREVIEW and its containing PATTERN_ATTEMPT reachability is FEATURE_GATED with a nonempty required feature set.
x-deeplus-machine-contract.no_recovery_unknown_rule: Every canonical discriminator is closed. Analysis recovery, unresolved, overload-set, unknown, and the two rejected pre-HIR patterns cannot validate.
focused_verifier_obligations: Recompute schema_digest and authority_digest from the selected machine contract and authority bundle.
Require every FEATURE_GATED required_feature_ids set to be a subset of the root feature_set.feature_ids and recompute feature_set_digest.
Require feature_ids and required_feature_ids to be deterministically sorted.
Resolve every payload_ref to exactly one GenericPayloadEnvelope in the same body.
Require payload owner_expr_id, owner_expr_kind, payload_contract_id, slot order, slot roles, reference classes, and cardinalities to exactly match the integrated identity catalog payload contract.
Require every structural plan to match exactly one of the thirteen StructuralPlan discriminators and require every optional value to use its required *_or_null field.
Require each named plan-reference slot to resolve to exactly one StructuralPlan whose structural_identity_id is the exact plan class required by that slot.

Reject missing or extra plan fields, unresolved or cross-body plan references, noncontiguous ordinals, cardinality mismatches, multiply-owned children, wrong reference domains, and omitted nullable encodings.
Reject missing, duplicate, orphan, cyclic, cross-body, or multiply-owned payload and node references.
Resolve PatternAttempt.lowering_id and pattern_kind_id to the same admitted pattern registry row.
Require each lowering-row hir_identity_ids entry to resolve in the exact 129-row catalog and to equal the identities implied by its dispatch key.

Allow only LOWER or NO_RUNTIME_EMISSION lowering rows. Capability insufficiency is not represented as a lowering row; preserve the verified HIR semantic digest exactly and do not create ExecutableHirH1.
